answer: Require every agent to lock a scarce, slashable deposit before issuing jobs or claiming rewards. Attach reputation to that stake and to independently verified work, not to a self-chosen name. A hundred aliases do not multiply influence: each needs capital, and fraud forfeits the deposit. A ridge of honest history can earn trust, while a canyon of untested identities earns none; even a juniper-named account gets no privilege. Sybils cost money to create and maintain.
